mentions.name: Dreamlist
mentions.description: A platform for collaborative shopping lists, online wishlists, and gift drives. It is ad-free and private, and multiple lists can be stacked into groups of lists to share on social media or with grandparents.
mentions.audience: Families and gift-givers sharing lists with relatives and on social media
mentions.source_excerpt: https://www.dreamlist.com - collaborative shopping lists and online wishlists and gift drive platform. Again ads-free, private, stack multiple lists into groups of lists to share on social media or with grandparents.
